name: Slow Cooker Sweet & Sour Cocktail Meatballs

instructions.primary_message: Place pork, beef, egg, bread crumbs, and spices in a medium bowl. Use your hands to combine the meatball mixture. Using a tablespoon measure, form the mixture into rounded meatballs and arrange in a single layer on a large baking sheet pan.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ lb ground pork sausage
½ lb lean ground beef
1 egg
¼ cup panko bread crumbs
¾ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place meatballs in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until browned and firm, 12-15 minutes (the meatballs will not be cooked all the way through). Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place apricot preserves, hot sauce, Worcestershire, and Dijon in a small bowl. Stir to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup apricot preserves
2 tsp hot sauce
1 tsp Worcestershire sauce
1 tsp Dijon mustard

instructions.primary_message: When the meatballs are partially cooked through, carefully transfer them to a 4-quart slow cooker insert, leaving behind any of the rendered fat.
Drizzle meatballs with sauce, cover, and cook until meatballs are cooked through, 3-4 hours on low or about 2 hours on high.
Transfer meatballs and sauce to a serving dish, then sprinkle with crushed red pepper. Serve with toothpicks and enjoy!
